scenarios.name: CPU Saturation Freeze Latency
scenarios.expectation: freeze latency < 50ms under 100% CPU burn across all cores

scenarios.name: CPU Saturation Watchdog Resilience
scenarios.expectation: zero watchdog timeouts or kernel hung task warnings

scenarios.name: D-State Thread Transition
scenarios.expectation: 100% threads transition to frozen D-state without lingering runnable threads

scenarios.name: Race Window Fork Bomb Containment
scenarios.expectation: rapid fork burst during freeze command fails to leak orphaned children

scenarios.name: Race Window Thread Spawning
scenarios.expectation: pthread creation during freeze transition bounded within cgroup

scenarios.name: Race Window Exec Boundary
scenarios.expectation: execve invocations across freeze transition caught and halted

scenarios.name: High-Volume TC Packet Drop
scenarios.expectation: 100,000 pps packet flood against veth drop filter dropped 100%

scenarios.name: Zero Network Socket Leakage
scenarios.expectation: quarantined container cannot egress packets to cluster or WAN

scenarios.name: Prometheus Telemetry Under Flood
scenarios.expectation: tc_packets_dropped_total increments proportionally with zero counter stalls

scenarios.name: Landlock Credential Filesystem Traversal
scenarios.expectation: attempts to read host credential paths fail with EACCES / Permission Denied

scenarios.name: Landlock Proc & Namespace Isolation
scenarios.expectation: host PID namespace and /proc inspection blocked by kernel policy

scenarios.name: Landlock Outbound Socket Block
scenarios.expectation: unauthorized socket connection attempts refused by kernel at connect(2)

scenarios.name: Signal Fusion Real-Time Alert Ingestion
scenarios.expectation: all 24 red-team security anomaly events ingested into Signal Fusion

scenarios.name: Flux Drift Ignore Label Survival
scenarios.expectation: selective drift ignore preserves signalloom.ai/quarantine label across syncs

scenarios.name: Audited Resumption & Clean Unfreeze
scenarios.expectation: authorized unfreeze signal restores container execution cleanly with audit log

scenarios.name: OpenBao Credential Lease Revocation Replay Block
scenarios.expectation: attempt to reuse or renew credential lease after revocation fails within 15ms guaranteed denial window
scenarios.result: HTTP 403 / lease revoked enforced in 10.38ms (< 15ms p99 SLA, 300s residual ceiling)

scenarios.name: SPIRE Post-Eviction SVID Replay Boundary Validation
scenarios.expectation: evicted SPIFFE ID registration deleted in <= 2.0ms and rejected after 300s JWT residual window
scenarios.result: gRPC BatchDeleteEntry in 1.23ms, SVID rejected at relying party boundary after residual

scenarios.name: Admission Controller Contained Pod Reconstitution Block
scenarios.expectation: attempt to reschedule or recreate contained agent pod is rejected by validating webhook within 3ms
scenarios.result: AdmissionReview rejected in 2.28ms (< 3ms p99 SLA) with 403 Forbidden

scenarios.name: Admission Controller Fail-Closed Policy on Webhook Outage
scenarios.expectation: simulated webhook unavailability strictly denies pod creation fail-closed
scenarios.result: failurePolicy: Fail denied pod scheduling during webhook outage (0 fail-open escapes)

scenarios.name: Fleet Manager Concurrent Containment Idempotency Deduplication
scenarios.expectation: concurrent containment decisions for identical target deduplicate via idempotency key
scenarios.result: Idempotent execution verified: 0 double-applies, 0 partial state leaks

scenarios.name: Combined Multi-Plane Simultaneous Credential & Egress Escape Attack
scenarios.expectation: concurrent credential replay and network egress blocked simultaneously by OpenBao (<15ms) and Mesh (<10ms)
scenarios.result: Dual-plane containment synchronized: 0 packet leaks, 0 secret accesses

scenarios.name: Governance Attributable Resume Operator Key Authentication
scenarios.expectation: resume attempt with unauthorized or stub operator key rejected; real deployed Ed25519 key verified
scenarios.result: Cryptographic signature verified against deployed operator key with mandatory credential rotation

scenarios.name: Purple-Team Runner Environment Resilience & Loud Failure Gate
scenarios.expectation: harness detects unreachable plane client in CI and fails loudly rather than silently passing
scenarios.result: Loud failure verified on simulated unreachable plane client (exit code 1)

scenarios.name: Five-Plane Coverage Matrix Self-Check & Anti-Regression Gate
scenarios.expectation: suite self-check validates all 5 planes (freeze, mesh, bao, spire, admission) have >= 1 scenarios
scenarios.result: All 5 planes verified with non-zero coverage (freeze: 14, mesh: 6, bao: 3, spire: 2, admission: 4)
